answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the summit of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the spiral re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the ripple of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
